objection.quote: A cut can interchange the two parity rows only above its level.
objection.witness: COUNTEREXAMPLE: take a column of height $2d$ and cut it into columns of heights $d/2$ and $3d/2$. Before the cut, $N(t)=1$ for $0<t<2d$. Afterwards, $N(t)=2$ for $0<t<d/2$, so parity changes below the cut level $d/2$, while for $d/2<t<3d/2$ it remains odd. Thus the asserted direction of the parity interchange is false.
objection.load_bearing: This assertion is the basis of the induction offered for refinement lemma (ii). Without a valid account of arbitrary cuts, (ii)—and hence protection of Liu's geometric partition—is not proved.
